title: Race Day Simulator
description: Generate your complete race day plan: per-kilometer pacing, nutrition, warm-up, timeline and checklist.

inputs.title: Race parameters
inputs.weightHint: Used to calibrate nutrition and hydration.
inputs.timeHint: Type the digits, they fall into place: 4500 reads 45:00, 33000 reads 3:30:00.
inputs.timeInvalid: That time does not read. Try 4500 for 45:00.
inputs.startInvalid: A start time runs from 0:00 to 23:59, for instance 830 for 8:30.
inputs.evenDesc: All splits at the same pace.

view.label: Display mode
view.prepareHint: The full plan, to read at your own pace.
view.raceDayHint: The essentials, in order, on the clock.

splits.negativeSummary: You speed up: {{first}} on the first split, {{last}} on the last.
splits.positiveSummary: You slow down: {{first}} on the first split, {{last}} on the last.

shared.banner: This simulation was shared with you. Adjust the inputs to match your own race.
shared.invalid: This share link is invalid or incomplete.

nutrition.noCarbs: Over {{duration}} of effort, no carbohydrate intake is needed. Focus on hydration.

empty: Enter your race parameters to generate your plan.

emptyState.timeline: The day's schedule, from wake-up to finish
emptyState.nutrition: What you drink and eat, and when
emptyState.mental: Mental cues broken down by segment

descriptionShort: Pick a race from your plan, or describe one: the whole day is set from it, from the evening before to the finish.

band.missing: Set the target and the start time: the whole day is set from them.
band.saveFailed: Your times were not kept on this device.
band.missingStart: Set the start time: the whole day is set from it.

morning.name: The morning
morning.title: Eat early, arrive with time to spare
morning.venue: On site, bib pick-up, find your pen

race.name: The race
race.trailSoon: Per-kilometre paces for trail are coming: the climbing decides everything, so they are not split yet.
race.fuel: Fuelling: {{carbs}} g of carbs per hour, {{gels}} gels, one every {{every}} min, and {{fluid}} ml of water per hour.
race.fuelWater: Fuelling: water to thirst, nothing else over {{minutes}} min.

after.name: After
after.title: Walk, drink, eat
after.body: Within 2 h: carbs and protein, at least 200 ml of water.

doc.passagesHint: Clock time at each split, start at {{time}}.

day.rehearsalIn_other: Your race is in {{count}} days. Slide the time to see what awaits you; on {{date}}, the clock will be the real one.
day.rehearsalNoDate: With no race date, the clock is never the real one: slide the time to walk through the day.

wake.title: Wake up
wake.detail: A glass of water, get up without lingering.

venue.title: On site
venue.detail: Bib pick-up, find your pen and the toilets.

strides.title: Strides

strides.detailTrail: 4 to 6 relaxed accelerations of 80 m, walk back.

race.title: The race
race.detail: Run your pace, not everyone else's.

finish.title: Finish
